items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-153 (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This update addresses eleven vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. It also fixes an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B allowing unauthenticated code execution (CVE-2026-92909, CVSS 9.8), stored cross-site scripting, and an admin input validation flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that resolves a critical vulnerability which could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution, with attacks starting on September 4, 2026. This flaw was later addressed by a hotfix mentioned in APSB26-153.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover (APSB26-92)
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92, an update fixing seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) that allows an attacker to switch a customer session to another account and escalate privileges. This update also addresses other critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-71
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.
